;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Halle synagogue shooting]]
**Two people are killed and two others are injured in attacks by a man wearing military camouflage near a [[synagogue]] and at a [[kebab shop]] in [[Halle (Saale)|Halle]], [[Saxony-Anhalt]], [[Germany]]. Shots are also reported in nearby [[Landsberg, Saxony-Anhalt|Landsberg]]. A suspect, 27-year-old Stephan Billiet, is arrested. The attack had been livestreamed on [[Twitch (service)|Twitch]] for 35 minutes citing anti-Semitic and racist motivations. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49988482 (BBC News)] [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-deadly-shooting-near-synagogue-in-halle/a-50751722 (DW)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/09/two-people-killed-in-shooting-in-german-city-of-halle (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria]], [[Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War]], [[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present)]]
**[[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] says his country has launched a military invasion of northern and eastern Syria. The [[Kurds|Kurdish]] [[People's Protection Units|YPG]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] say that Turkish fighter aircraft strike targets and "civilian areas". [[Television in Syria|Syrian state television]] says the Turkish artillery shelling of [[Ras al-Ayn]], [[al-Hasakah Governorate]], is "random", and [[Ayn Issa]], [[Raqqa Governorate]], is also being shelled. [https://www.dw.com/en/erdogan-turkey-launches-offensive-in-northern-syria/a-50758501 (Deutsche Welle)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/turkey-syria-border-latest-updates-191008131745495.html (Al Jazeera)] [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-10/09/c_138458986.htm (Xinhuanet)]
**The [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] requests urgent air support from the [[United States]], and a [[no-fly zone]] over [[Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria|northern Syria]] to protect it from Turkish air raids. [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] has ordered U.S. forces to not intervene in the conflict. [https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-turkey-zone/sdf-urges-no-fly-zone-to-stop-turkish-attacks-in-northeast-syria-idUKKBN1WO1OQ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-49983357 (BBC News)]
**Women at the SDF-controlled [[Al-Hawl refugee camp]], which holds around 74,000 refugees, mostly the wives and children of [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] fighters, riot and burn their tents according to a Kurdish security official. [https://www.kurdistan24.net/en/news/0d97f37e-b24f-4b1b-b816-2293f03931e7 (Kurdistan24)]
**The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] takes two militants of the [[The Beatles (terrorist cell)|Beatles ISIL cell]] previously held by Kurdish forces to face trial in the [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-usa-beatles/u-s-military-takes-custody-of-two-high-profile-islamic-state-militants-idUSKBN1WO2XG?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/isis-beatles-transferred-syrian-prison-us-military-custody/story?id=66172473 (ABC News)]
**Multiple reports that [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] has committed multiple [[Suicide attack|suicide bombings]] in the [[Syria]]n [[Cities and towns during the Syrian Civil War|city]] of [[Raqqa]]. [https://time.com/5695812/islamic-state-militants-hit-kurdish-fighters-syria/ (''Time'')]
*[[Military activity of ISIL]]
**[[President of Niger]] [[Mahamadou Issoufou]] claims that [[Americans|American]] hostage [[Jeffery Ray Woodke]] is still alive and being held by a [[jihad]]ist group affiliated with [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]]. Woodke was kidnapped in October 2016. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/american-hostage-held-isis-alive-niger-president/story?id=66124077 (ABC News)]

;Business and economy
*The [[OECD]] releases a set of proposals, for the 134 countries which accepted the principle, to discuss and negotiate a change in [[international taxation]] of the big digital and consumer goods companies' global profits. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-oecd-tax-factbox/factbox-international-tax-faces-biggest-shake-up-in-decades-under-oecd-plan-idUSKBN1WO1AN (Reuters)]
*[[International sanctions during the Venezuelan crisis]]
**[[Adobe Inc.|Adobe]] cuts access to its software and cancels all [[Creative Cloud]] memberships in Venezuela, to comply with [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s trade restrictions. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-49973337 (BBC News)]
*[[European debt crisis]]
**[[Greece]] issues new three-month debt at a [[Interest rate#On government bond yields|negative interest rate]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/5dde46c4-ea83-11e9-a240-3b065ef5fc55 (''Financial Times'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Tunisian presidential election]]
**An appeals court in Tunisia releases candidate [[Nabil Karoui]] from prison, days before the second round of the presidential election. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/tunisia-presidential-candidate-nabil-karoui-freed-191009162728678.html (Al Jazeera)]

**[[President of Ecuador|Ecuadorian President]] [[Lenín Moreno]] says that he will not resign "under any circumstance" and continues with his [[Government of Ecuador|government]] in [[Guayaquil]].
